csv_scope_of_work: Avery County seeks to engage a qualified engineering firm to conduct a comprehensive repair and replacement assessment for the Avery County Parks and Recreation Department. This project will involve the evaluation of the 4.98-acre Little League Fields that sustained damage during Hurricane Helene. The assessment should include, but not be limited to, evaluating and recommending repairs or replacements for damaged infrastructure such as fencing, sod, bleachers, restrooms, and other necessary renovations to restore the park to a fully functional facility, and including the improvements on the attached scope of work

title: Assessment for Parks Repair & Replacement
short_description: Engineering assessment for repairing hurricane-damaged park facilities and recreational infrastructure.
project_location: Newland, Avery County, North Carolina, USA
project_scope: Comprehensive repair and replacement assessment for the Avery County Parks and Recreation Department focused on the 4.98-acre Little League Fields damaged during Hurricane Helene. The assessment covers evaluation and recommendations for repair or replacement of damaged park infrastructure including fencing, sod, bleachers, restrooms, and other renovations needed to restore the facility to full operation.

relevance_explanation:

- Scope focuses on damaged recreational infrastructure such as fencing, sod, bleachers, and restrooms.
- Includes engineering and architectural services, but no clear structural complexity or innovative load-bearing structure.
- Sports-related context exists, but this is not a stadium, arena, or major sports hall.
- Early assessment role may offer limited strategic entry, yet overall fit with sbp core profile is low.
